title: “Just eat in moderation” is the worst fat loss advice desi men get. 👇
hook: “Just eat in moderation” is the worst fat loss advice desi men get. 👇
caption:
“Just eat in moderation” is the worst fat loss advice desi men get. 👇

Nobody tells you what moderation actually looks like on your plate.

Here’s what it really means:

1️⃣ Balance, not less of everything. Have protein, carbs and veg on the same plate.
2️⃣ Keep the rice, but measure it. About ¼ of your plate, or 1 cup cooked.
3️⃣ Protein first. Eat the chicken before the rice and you’ll stay full for longer.
4️⃣ Don’t skip the raita. Yoghurt adds protein and is good for your gut.

Try it at your next meal: fill ½ the plate with protein and salad, ¼ with rice or roti, and add a side of raita.
